content: Pita ꞌina ayausa Konilio ꞌenaya
Ta ꞌasa Sisalia ꞌenaya ꞌebweu tai ꞌana esana Konilio ꞌimiyami. Tauna me Loma tolosaiyao ꞌadi yau analedi ꞌidi toanugana, boda Itali ꞌenega,
ta tauna tai boboꞌana ga ma ina susuyao Yaubada siꞌamayabena, ta tuta yauna togomabeso ꞌilemelemedi ta ꞌisidasida Yaubada ꞌena.
Ta ꞌasiyata ꞌebweu ꞌena ꞌasuinuwanuwaya, Konilio nina ꞌina ꞌenomataꞌitaꞌita ꞌenega Yaubada ꞌina anilose ꞌebweu ꞌimeema ꞌenaya, ga ꞌiꞌita ꞌaiꞌailina, ta anilose nina ꞌigwae, “Konilio!”

Ta Konilio anilose nina ꞌiduneduneyena ga ma ina matauta, ta ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana! Toꞌase?” Ta anilose ꞌigwae, “Yaubada ꞌimu sidasida be ꞌimu lema togomabeso ꞌediya ꞌimwalatonina, ga manudi ꞌinuwaꞌiꞌisimu.
ꞌEnega ꞌimu toguinuwao ꞌaidi ꞌuetunedi be sitatauya Yopa, be Saimoni tauna sieesena Pita siꞌauꞌewenama.
Ta Pita nina ꞌebweu wate Saimoni ꞌina anuwa leꞌawaya ꞌenaya ꞌimiyami, ta Saimoni nina ꞌina paisewa yobai bwaladiyega gwegwe ꞌiguiguinuwedi.”
Anilose nina ꞌina ona ꞌigumwala ga ꞌitauya, ꞌenega Konilio ꞌina toguinuwao ꞌediyega ꞌeluwa ꞌibwauyedi ma ina tolosaiya ꞌebweuna, tauna wate Yaubada ꞌana toꞌamayaba sinabwana.
ꞌEnega anilose ꞌina simana Konilio ꞌiemwasalina sitetoi nidi ꞌediya, ga ꞌietunedi Yopa ꞌenaya, ga sitauya.
Mali ꞌasiyataya ꞌasuoleoleya ꞌetamo sitautauya ga ꞌasa Yopa siloselabena, ta Pita anuwaya ꞌimiyami ga ꞌituꞌe etaninaya sabi sidasida.
ꞌIsidasida ta ma ina botana sinabwana. ꞌEtamo anuwaya masula sigibugibubu ga Pita ꞌiꞌenomataꞌitaꞌita,
ga galewa ꞌiꞌitena ꞌiꞌegegena ga ꞌebweu yage ꞌiꞌitena ꞌimwaꞌutama, ꞌana ꞌita ꞌatuwa kaleko sinabwana tupitupina ata ꞌediyega sietabe mwaꞌutenama baleꞌuya,
ta solanaya mali yobai, be mali yobai, be yobai kawakawalidi, be mali manuwa be mali manuwa.
ꞌEnega ꞌebweu ꞌenana Pita ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “Pita, ꞌutoolo be yobai nate ꞌuunudi be ꞌuꞌaꞌa ꞌamu masula.”
Ta Pita ꞌiguitoyasa, ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, tuwa, manuna nigeya ꞌebweu wate yobai ꞌetoꞌetobodana getedi nadigega yada ꞌenidi.”
Ta ꞌenana nina ꞌiona limana, ꞌigwae, “Yaubada yobai natedi niꞌatu ꞌigieꞌesasedi, ꞌenega geyaꞌabo ꞌuꞌawaꞌawa toꞌumaliyedi.”
Yage gete matoi Pita ꞌena ꞌiapwesa, ga ꞌenana nina matoi nadigega ꞌieonena, ga muliyega yage nina ꞌiila galewaya.

Ta Pita ꞌinuwanuwa edaedadama ꞌaene toꞌase ꞌenomataꞌitaꞌita gete niꞌatu ꞌiꞌitena, ta tomota ꞌetoi nidi Konilio ꞌietunedima siapwesa anuwaya, manuna niꞌatu ꞌasaya simai ga Saimoni ꞌina anuwa tomota ꞌediya sienaida.
ꞌEnega silobena ga anuwa ꞌawanaya sitoolo ta sibwau, “Gosemao, Saimoni nina sieesena Pita, nate anuwaya ꞌimiyami, nai nigeya?”
Ta anuwa nina etaninaya Pita ma ina nuwa edaedadama ꞌimiyami, ta Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌena ꞌigwae, “Pita, tai ꞌetoi siꞌebeꞌebeseyo, ta niꞌatu simai ga ꞌagalauya.
ꞌEnega ꞌutoolo be ꞌumwaꞌuta ꞌediya be maꞌemwao watatauya, ta geyaꞌabo ꞌuꞌateꞌate saꞌala, manuna ꞌaboꞌagu tomota nidi yaetunedima.”
ꞌEnega Pita nina ꞌimwaꞌuta ꞌediya ga ꞌigwae, “ꞌAboꞌagu Pita! Toꞌase manuna wamai?”

Ta sigwae, “Konilio ꞌietunema, tauna ꞌima tolosaiyao ꞌadi toanugana, ta tai palupaluna ta Yaubada ꞌana toꞌamayaba, ta wate me Yudia maiboꞌadi siꞌawa tai boboꞌanena, ga ꞌana emataluwa ꞌinonona anilose ꞌenega, be ꞌaene ꞌoyo ꞌibwauyeyo tauna ꞌina anuwaya, be ꞌimu ona ꞌida nono.”
ꞌEnega Pita tai nidi ꞌibwauyedi, ga anuwa nina ꞌena sieꞌowaga. ꞌEnega tomwa ꞌiulisina ga sitoolo ga Pita maꞌediya sitauya, ta ꞌaidi gosediyao Yopa ꞌenega maꞌediyao wate sitauya.
Sitautauya ga mali ꞌasiyataya siapwesa Sisaliya. Ta gote ꞌenaya Konilio ꞌina susuyao be gosenao ꞌibwau egogonedimaya, ga ꞌina anuwaya siyamwayamwa.
ꞌEnega Pita ꞌilogedoma anuwaya ta Konilio ꞌiaapwesa, ga Pita matanaya ꞌibeꞌu sanamwaꞌuta ga ꞌibwagobwago.
Ta Pita Konilio ꞌigietoolona, ta ꞌigwae, “ꞌUtoolo! ꞌAboꞌagu tomotai tuga, nadigega ꞌoyo.”
ꞌEnega Pita be Konilio maꞌiyana sieonaona, ta silugu anuwaya, ga Pita boda anuwa solanaya ꞌiꞌitedi,

ga ꞌieonedi, “ꞌOmi ꞌaboꞌama me Yudia ꞌama loina wamwalamwalatoni ꞌaene nigeya sawesawemaya be ꞌomi nigeya me Yudia ꞌayausimi, nai maꞌemao taegosigosiyana, ta saꞌi Yaubada niꞌatu ꞌenomataꞌiteꞌitega ꞌieꞌitegu be geyaꞌabo ꞌebweu tomota yaꞌawaꞌawa toꞌumaliyei.
ꞌEnega tuta nina Konilio ꞌibwauyeguma, nigeya yaguiguitoyasa, ta esi yatagwalegu ga niꞌatu yamai. Ta toꞌase manuna ꞌubwauyeguma?”

ꞌEnega Konilio ꞌigwae, “Gete manuna: ꞌAsiyata ata sigumwala ꞌena ꞌasuinuwanuwaya, nadigega gete tuga sidasida ꞌana tuta, ꞌenega ꞌigu anuwaya yasidasida Yaubada ꞌena, ga ꞌebweu tai yaꞌitena mataguya ꞌitootoolo ma ꞌana ꞌoama ꞌesasena.
Ta ꞌieonegu, ‘Konilio, Yaubada ꞌimu sidasida niꞌatu ꞌinonodi, ta wate ꞌimu lema gomabeso ꞌediya ꞌinuwaꞌiꞌisidi.

ꞌEnega ꞌimu ꞌaliꞌeiyao ꞌuetunedi Yopa ꞌena be Saimoni ꞌubwauyenama, tauna sieesena Pita, ta mali Saimoni ꞌina anuwaya, Yopa ꞌena leꞌawaya, ꞌimiyami, ta mali Saimoni nina ꞌina guinuwa yobai bwaladiyega gwegwe ꞌiguiguinuwedi.’

ꞌEnega yalomanini ga ꞌigu ꞌaliꞌeiyao nidi yaetunediwaya ga sibwauyemuma, ta ꞌutagwalemuya ga ꞌumai, ga kagutoki. ꞌEnega gete tuga maiboꞌama Yaubada matanaya ꞌadeli egogonama, be toꞌase ꞌInapwana ꞌiloinemuya ꞌuda eonama, be ꞌada nono.”
Pita ꞌina ona Konilio ma ina bodao ꞌediya
ꞌEnega Pita ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Onaꞌaiꞌaila! Niꞌatu nuwagu ꞌisabwalena ꞌaene tomota maiboꞌadi Yaubada matanaya leleleya, ta nigeya me Yudia mamo ꞌiobobomema,
ta esi mali sena be mali sena tomoteninao, ꞌeguma siꞌamayabena be sibubuna palupalu, ꞌigwausowala manudi.
Ta Toꞌetoseyana Yesu, tauna maiboꞌada ꞌida ꞌInapwana, ga Yaubada ꞌina tetela boboꞌana Yesu ꞌiꞌebwaꞌena, ꞌaboꞌama me Isileli ꞌima ꞌebe gwausowala manuna. Ta ꞌomi tetela nina wamwalamwalatoni,
manuna Yoni tetela nina ꞌieꞌalena Galili ꞌenega, tuta nina ꞌiloguguya, ga tomota ꞌigiebapitaisoedi ga muliyega Yesu tetelina ꞌiꞌelelewana Yudia senanao maiboꞌadi ꞌediya.

Tetela nina ꞌaene Yaubada Yesu goma Nasaleta ꞌigiewaiwaiyena Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌenega, ga ꞌisakosakowasi ga tomota ꞌilemelemedi, ta ꞌabo yaisigedi Seitani be yaluyaluwa toꞌumalidi sigieleꞌoasidiya, Yesu ꞌigieboboꞌanedi, manuna Yaubada ꞌina waiwai ꞌenaya ꞌimiyami.
Ta ꞌaboꞌama saꞌi Yesu ꞌana tosimanao, manuna ꞌina guinuwao ꞌaꞌitediya Yudia senanao maiboꞌadi ꞌediya be wate Yelusalema ꞌenaya, ga ꞌana ꞌebe losalowa kaiwe ꞌena situtu epaꞌiyena ga ꞌimwawasa,
ta ꞌasiyata ꞌetonina ꞌenaya Yaubada ꞌigietoolo limena, ga ꞌigieapwesena,
nigeya tomota maiboꞌadi ꞌediya, nate namo ꞌaboꞌama Yaubada ꞌiesinuwema ꞌana tosimanao, ꞌemaya, ga ꞌina toololimana mulinaya ꞌaꞌeꞌai ta ꞌanumanuma Yesu nina maꞌemai.

“Ga ꞌiloinema be tomota ꞌediya ꞌaloguguya ꞌaene Yaubada Yesu nina ꞌiesinuwena be ꞌaene tuta ꞌana ꞌebe losalowa ꞌena tauna bwaꞌomatana ꞌida guinuwa, tomota taudi niꞌatu simwawasa manudi, be wate ꞌaboꞌada mayawasida manuda.
“Palopitao wate lowaenei sigimi simanena ꞌaene ꞌeguma yaisigedi Yesu ꞌena siemiemisa, ꞌidi loegesiyao Yaubada ꞌida nuwataudi, Yesu tauna ꞌana esanega.”
Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌimwaꞌuta taudi nigeya me Yudia ꞌediya
Pita ꞌetamo ꞌionaona ga Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌimwaꞌuta taudi sienoenono ꞌediya,

ga mali ꞌenana be mali ꞌenana ꞌediyega sionaona, ta Yaubada situputupu, ta me Yudia taudi Yesu ꞌana toemisao nidi, Pita maꞌenao Yopa ꞌenega simaiya, sinuwaowana, manuna siꞌitena Yaubada niꞌatu Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌiꞌebwaya taudi nigeya me Yudia ꞌediya. ꞌEnega Pita ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae,
“Gosegwao! Waꞌita! Yaluyaluwa Tabuna niꞌatu siꞌewena, nadigega lowa ꞌaboꞌada. ꞌEnega nigeya sawesawenaya ꞌidi bapitaiso bwasiyega taꞌetobode, aga?”
ꞌEnega Pita nina ꞌiloina be Toꞌetoseyana Yesu ꞌana esanega sida bapitaiso, ga muliyega tomota nidi Pita sisidena be ꞌaina ꞌasiyata wate maꞌediya sida miyami, ga ꞌitagwala.
